meta.angle: Selfie Cancellato - digital self-rejection (pain v4 + brand v2)
meta.pain-targeted: "Quanti selfie hai cancellato questo mese?" - rifiuto digitale moderno

image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference) holding her smartphone up showing the screen toward camera. On the phone screen we see a Photos app interface with a prominent red trash/delete icon highlighted - she has just deleted or is about to delete a photo. A blurred selfie thumbnail is visible on the screen (not identifiable). Her expression: direct knowing slight smile, raised eyebrow - "we all do this" coach energy.
She wears practical home clothes (simple top, comfortable). Clean modern home setting, neutral background (white or soft beige wall), bright natural daylight, NEUTRAL white-balanced color (NOT golden hour Mediterranean).
CRITICAL STYLE: COACH talking-head Instagram energy, clean modern photography, NOT cinematic intimate. Real Italian woman 45, real skin, no retouching. Phone tilted toward camera so screen content visible (but selfie blurred).
Composition: Elena chest-up center frame, phone visible held up showing screen, plenty of clean negative space top/bottom for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic intimate, Spike Jonze Her aesthetic, sad contemplation, dim lighting, blue glow dramatic, vintage filter, sad expression, fashion editorial, instagram filter, beauty filter, makeup heavy, model thin, photo on screen clearly visible

design-brief.instructions: Layout brand WINNER v5 con foto Elena.

copy-for-meta-ads-manager.primary-text:

❌ Quanti ne hai scattati che non hai mai postato? ❌ Quanti gruppi WhatsApp hai mutato per non vedere le foto delle altre in vacanza?
